{{Infobox auto}}

'''Steamed carrots''' are the simple preparation of the [[carrot]]. They heal {{Value|Steamed Carrots|heals}} and grant {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for {{Value|Steamed Carrots|duration|effect=Night Vision}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/steamed_carrots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A carrot cooks into steamed carrots in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Steamed Carrots|cook_time}}. Picking up a carrot unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating steamed carrots takes {{Value|Steamed Carrots|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Steamed Carrots|heals}} and gives Night Vision for {{Value|Steamed Carrots|duration|effect=Night Vision|format=clock}}.

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
